description: Fail-closed pre-payment trust gate — GenLayer validator consensus on a checkout URL before your agent pays.

private_key.title: Your GenCheck private key (optional)
private_key.description: Private key (0x...) of YOUR funded studio-dev account. Every validation is a real transaction, so it runs on your account and spends your GEN — fund it free at https://studio-next.genlayer.com (connect wallet, click Fund). Stored in your OS keychain, never written to the repo. Leave this empty to use the free read-only checks, which need no key.
